تجتاحون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَاحُونَ (tajtāḥūna) /tad͡ʒ.taː.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# تُجْتَاحُونَ (tujtāḥūna) /tud͡ʒ.taː.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
